issues.summary: The device guard checks the input tensor's device rather than the effective output device, so factory-like random ops such as rand_like/randn_like with an explicit device override (e.g. CPU-local DTensor on a CUDA mesh with device="cuda") are now wrongly rejected instead of using the CUDA RNG tracker.
Add regression tests for a CPU input with CUDA output via an explicit device override for rand_like and randn_like.
